items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I know Sam Lutz, because at one time Sam Lutz was with Gabie Lutz and Heller, and I was with them for awhile, for a short time, Gabie Lutz and Heller.

ctx.x: Well, my mother, after my dad passed, my mother, we brought her out to California. She stayed with me, and she -- every Saturday night, you know, she would listen to Lawrence Welk, whether I was home or not. He was her favorite, and she would listen to him, whether or not, on Saturday night, Lawrence Welk. She just adored him, just absolutely adored him.

So I got in the habit of looking at him also, and of course I know Sam Lutz, because at one time Sam Lutz was with Gabie Lutz and Heller, and I was with them for awhile, for a short time, Gabie Lutz and Heller.
